reviewer: weight_diagnostics assistant; not independent human review
review_method: Read every frozen holdout criterion and all 80 full actual replies plus every call, fixture and post-tool reply. Explicit case judgments enforce full-answer correctness and requested form, with actual-history recall assessed against actual outputs even when an earlier call failed. No inference, selection edits or tuning. Borderline actual-history judgments aligned with selected-candidate reviewer.
